content.comment_body: Hello, The LSC tool operates well on my local network. As I will need to adjust the [product_name] program after it's installed for a remote client, I am looking to enable remote access using LSC. Is it possible to do so through the cloud, or do I need to configure port forwarding? If so, which port should be forwarded? I've seen mentions of port 8080 but I'm not sure if that's exclusively for [product_name] Web Editor. Thanks.

Hello, Based on my experience, you need to forward port 102. When accessing the [product_name] device over the Internet, use the public IP of the client's location. I have connected this way successfully a few times.
